authorized_scope: Train a corrected selection-protocol version and submit a new PR; previous PR remains closed.

training_source.name: ASE G2 molecular database
training_source.target: experimental atomization energies extrapolated from heats of formation using ZPE and thermal corrections, converted kcal/mol to eV with ASE units

outer_split.group: complete molecular chemical formula; all isomers and spin variants together
outer_split.algorithm: sort unique formulas by SHA256(str(seed)+':' + formula); first ceil(0.2*n_groups) held out, remainder training

inner_selection.search: 16-trial GP expected improvement; 8 initial seeded Sobol proposals; seed42
inner_selection.objective: formula-macro atomization-energy MAE of out-of-fold training predictions; 2% minimum gain before nonzero correction is eligible

fixed_representation.readout: sum over unordered periodic neighbor pairs; conservative analytic force and stress; no atom-count specialist restriction

comparison_controls: equal-budget Sobol search, never used to reselect BO candidate
heldout_evaluation: Freeze candidate and code before exporting/reading holdout labels. Evaluate once and report all groups. Do not retrain/reselect using holdout or official score feedback.

benchmark_exposure.reason: Earlier PET and ORB diatomics scores and public task ranking informed the backbone and redesign. Historical exposure remains even with training-only selection.

official_evaluation: Use the unmodified official Python3.14 shared runner, scorer and default grid. No training on official homonuclear labels, no candidate-specific exclusions, no rank-based checkpoint choice.
publication_policy: Report all improvements and regressions including the unchanged-backbone control. Do not claim superiority if baseline is better, or unpublished official website ranks. Submission acceptance is for maintainers to assess.
purpose: A general multi-atom conservative energy calibration with a held-out molecular evaluation; not a diatomics-only fine-tune, not a demonstrated universal bulk/MD improvement.
compute: Local CPU, one torch thread, no paid services; original environments and artifacts preserved. Use a documented uv project override for dm-tree0.1.10, required for Python3.14 wheels.
